title: Dry-Sponge DNA Extraction
author: Amir reza Varzandi
materials: Extract the sponge liquid by squizing the sponge.
Discard the supernatant and take up to 250 mg of the sediment into PowerBead tubes (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany)

steps.title: Transfer sponge extract
steps.instruction: Pour the liquid extracted from the sponge into 50 mL centrifuge tubes (expect ~15 mL, e.g., Longmire's buffer).

steps.title: Add precipitation reagents
steps.instruction: Add 33 mL of pure ethanol and 1.0 mL of 3 M sodium acetate to each tube, bringing the total volume to approximately 50 mL.

steps.title: Cool centrifuge and spin
steps.instruction: Set the centrifuge temperature to 4–8 °C, then centrifuge the samples at 4000 g for 80 min at 6 °C.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 g for 80 min at 6 °C.

steps.title: Extract DNA with kit
steps.instruction: Proceed with DNA purification following the DNeasy PowerSoil kit instructions.
